Use case: identity-preserve.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the newly drawn W sprite. Paint ONE new cast/W/15 frame. Images 2/3/4 are the authoritative portrait, W idle camera and approved painted game-art style. Far anatomical RIGHT hand grips fan of EXACTLY FIVE separate red rectangular talisman cards, their five rectangular top edges clearly countable. Continuous sleeve-wrist-hand connection, no third sleeve. Do not swap props.
THIS FRAME POSE: Almost back to starting ready stance. Match target full-canvas framing and exact head pixels. Far RIGHT elbow relaxed with the same exactly FIVE-panel fan at chest height, hand about1% canvas higher than the ready target and wrist turned5degrees outward. Near LEFT hand holds bell at upper thigh, handle gripped and bell body slightly forward left, tassel finishing a small swing. Soft knees, shoes in target's short stagger with rear heel fully settled; pure screen-left calm face. Ribbon and robe settle, only residual motion, no new attack or lunge.
Preserve the chestnut high ponytail, jewel crown, flame-pattern red/gold short robe, black trousers, yin-yang waist ornament, red/black/gold shoes, youthful face and rounded clean richly painted Taoist chibi style. The body can naturally rise/fall a little while bending knees; the head and all props keep identical pixel dimensions. Ground virtual y920 and root x512 at1024. No automatic per-frame resizing. Keep both hands and feet separated and readable.
Single native square frame at least1024x1024 with genuine transparent RGBA, no scenery, shadows, light effects, detached flames, particles, text or labels. No contact sheet, only this single pose.
